# Method Basics

#### Course: Learn Recursion With Java

## Method Basics

We know that methods are independent pieces of code that can be reused again and again. In many ways, they're like machines that can take input(s) to produce an output.

In technical terms, Java methods usually consist of the following:

- Arguments - What values the method might take.
- Return Value - What value the method will return.

![Using arguments and return value allows us to make a method an independent piece of code.](data:image/png;base64,)
